searchEvidence: rg -n 'JsonSerializable\(typeof' src: of the ten production JsonSerializerContext types, only FirmwareFamilyDocument and CompositionProfileDocument are registered twice, in Infrastructure ProfileBundleJsonContext and Profiles ProfileBundleSemanticJsonContext, with identical JsonSourceGenerationOptions (out-of-order metadata, camelCase, case-sensitive, unmapped members disallowed, metadata mode).

Generated sources at cf4e42697 (EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles): ProfileBundleJsonContext 141 files / 19,748 lines and ProfileBundleSemanticJsonContext 139 files / 19,378 lines share 137 type files, 136 of them byte-identical after renaming the namespace and context (only the per-context GetJsonTypeInfo switch differs). Every other cross-context overlap is primitive metadata (String, Int32, Int64, Boolean, IReadOnlyList<string>, IReadOnlyList<long>).

Both registrations bind the same trusted JsonElement in one load: TrustedProfileBundleDocumentProjection.ValidateAndClone verifies DTO compatibility through ProfileBundleJsonContext, then TrustedProfileBundleCatalogFactory and CompositionProfileNormalizer deserialize it through ProfileBundleSemanticJsonContext, so each process builds two metadata graphs and the verified contract could drift from the consumed one. Profiles cannot reference Infrastructure; Infrastructure references Profiles, which friends Infrastructure (ProjectDependencyTests.LowerSemanticProjectsDoNotFriendBootstrapWithoutCallers), so the Profiles context is the only owner both can reach.

Not duplicates, left unchanged: VersionManagementJsonContext is the single owner of its nine version-management roots, and its eight per-codec instances carry each codec's own MaxDepth (equal to its strict-parse depth) and WriteIndented only where the codec writes; ToolchainRuntimeConfigurationJsonContext, EventBufferFormatConfigurationJsonContext, SystemDiagnosticsJsonContext, CanonicalCapabilityPolicyJsonContext, RuntimeTrustProbeJson, AbMergeFormatReportJsonContext and SourceEnvelopeRunReportJsonContext each own distinct roots.
semanticOwner: ProfileBundleSemanticJsonContext (Profiles) becomes the only generated metadata for FirmwareFamilyDocument and CompositionProfileDocument, shared by the Infrastructure trust projection and the Profiles catalog factory; ProfileBundleJsonContext keeps only the bundle manifest root. TrustedProfileBundleDocumentProjection remains the only trust-time DTO compatibility check and ProfileBundleLoader the only bundle trust gateway.
terminalContract: Trusted bundle loading verifies canonical family and profile DTO compatibility with the same generated metadata that the Profiles catalog factory consumes. Accepted and rejected documents, error messages, the projection's cloned JSON trees, the published catalog snapshot, profiles, schemas, contracts, firmware bytes, ranges and JSON outputs are unchanged; no serialization path is touched.
